why: Drawing shows a deep opening whose bottom terminates in a rounded U curve rather than a sharp point; the photo vest opening is likewise scooped with a clearly rounded U base above the first button, unlike the sharp V seen in the other vest photos.

Option is Left Besom with Flap, but the photographed chest pocket is a bare rectangular besom slit with no flap hanging below the opening. Position (wearer left chest) and count are right, yet the defining flap is absent - the pipeline clearly can render flaps, as vest-lower-slant-flap.webp shows one.

Drawing marks a single square patch outline on the wearer left chest; the photo shows exactly one applied patch pocket with topstitched edges and rounded bottom corners on the wearer left chest, right of the button placket.

Drawing marks two welts, one on each chest side, but the photo shows only a single chest welt on the wearer left; the wearer right chest carries no visible welt. The count that defines Right and Left Welt is not depicted, so the image reads as the single left-welt option.

Two failures against the drawing two flapped chest besoms: only one chest pocket appears (wearer left), and that pocket is a plain besom slit with no flap. Both the count (2 vs 1) and the flap construction contradict the option.

Drawing marks two patch outlines flanking the button placket; the photo shows a full patch pocket with rounded lower corners on the wearer left chest plus the matching patch pocket at the frame left edge on the wearer right chest - count of two and patch construction both match.

Drawing places straight horizontal welts low on the fronts; the photo lower pocket is a horizontal, unflapped, very narrow welt strip consistent with a 1.0 cm width, sitting between the lower buttons. Exact width cannot be measured, but orientation, height and construction match.

Drawing is a cropped lower-front view with straight horizontal pocket marks; the photo shows a horizontal jetted/besom opening with clean lipped edges, no flap and no slant, at the same low position above the vest point.

Drawing shows two applied patch outlines low on both fronts; the photo shows two symmetric patch pockets with rounded bottom corners applied on top of the fabric, one each side of the buttoned placket above the vest point.

Slant direction matches the drawing exactly: both drawn marks rise toward the center front and drop toward the side seams, and both photographed welts do the same with mirrored angles, with no flaps and two pockets present.

Drawing shows two slanted besom slits angled high at center front and low toward the sides; the photo shows two flapless slanted jetted openings with the identical angle and mirroring, positioned low between the placket buttons.

Drawing shows slanted besom outlines angled up toward center front; the photo lower pocket on the wearer right front carries a shaped flap with an angled lower edge over a slanted besom, and the slant runs high at the center-front end and low toward the side seam, matching the drawn direction.
